title: PowerPoint on desktop: Copilot Agent Mode applies an attached deck's theme and styles to a new presentation
summary: Hold: the summary promises that no admin action is required, but Microsoft does not state that for this feature. The rollout facts, attachment workflow and licence-assignment controls are supported; feature-specific licensing and admin prerequisites remain undocumented.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The attachment capability is user-opt-in rather than a documented change to presentations created without attaching a deck.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode admin enable disable attached presentation. Opened release-notes, configure-copilot-admin-center and wordexcelppt-agents on Learn; attachment is a user step, with no feature-specific switch or change for non-attachment documented.

claims.claim: No admin action is required.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode admin enable disable attached presentation. Opened Learn release-notes, configure-copilot-admin-center and wordexcelppt-agents; none states that this feature requires no admin action or resolves its Agent Mode prerequisites.
claims.fix: Replace 'Users choose it; no admin action is required, and no new licence is published.' with 'Users choose whether to attach a deck; feature-specific admin prerequisites and licensing are not yet documented.'

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Licence assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the **Users** > [Active users] ... Select the row of the user ... In the right pane, select **Licenses and Apps**. ... Expand the **Licenses** section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense with UserId, AddLicenses containing SkuId, and empty RemoveLicenses assigns the selected licence to the user.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least a License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.where: controls[0].governs and note; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The row governs who holds a licence giving Copilot in PowerPoint access as a whole, not a switch specifically for deck attachment.
claims.quote: You **have** the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on license with access to the full experience of Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The sources describe no attachment-related action running without a user prompt.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot in PowerPoint Agent Mode attached presentation autonomous. Read roadmap 555880 and the Learn release-notes attachment entry; the documented workflow requires selecting a file and requesting slide generation.

claims.claim: A feature-specific admin setting for Agent Mode deck attachment in PowerPoint is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode admin enable disable attached presentation; Agent Mode license. Opened Learn release-notes, configure-copilot-admin-center and wordexcelppt-agents; the Anthropic requirement is for agents in the Copilot app, not identified with this feature.

claims.claim: Learn describes an Anthropic-model enablement requirement for Word, Excel and PowerPoint Agents in the Microsoft Copilot app.
claims.quote: These agents exclusively use Anthropic's AI models. This AI model must be enabled. These requirements are mandatory for [Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Agents](wordexcelppt-agents) to function.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/wordexcelppt-agents to sources for the existing statement about the Anthropic models setting for agents in the Microsoft Copilot app; retain the separate uncertainty about Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not document whether Agent Mode deck attachment in PowerPoint depends on the Anthropic models setting.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode admin enable disable attached presentation; Agent Mode license. Opened Learn release-notes and wordexcelppt-agents; the latter specifies agents in the Copilot app and does not connect its Anthropic requirement to this in-PowerPoint feature.
